plan.title: Recreate live RFQ order with defaults

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ event instead of creating or searching for another event.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the tenant configuration specified for the scenario.
Allow the live event configuration required by the case.
Apply the vendor masking configuration specified for the scenario.
Reach the RFQ Responses tab where the Settings control is available.
Open Recreate Order from the RFQ Settings menu.

args.goal: Inspect the Recreate Order window, leave every field at the value it opened with, submit it, and stop when the window has closed and the new order creation result is visible.

steps.note: Perform the default-value submission and verify that the dialog closes after saving.
Assert the expected confirmation that the new order was created.
